gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-erode: Erode has a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, so text moves smoothly. Stencilia's gappy, structural capitals sit above it, while the body's gently swelling strokes carry a long page with an editorial, dignified ease.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-trench-slab: Gaps open up at the curve ends of Stencilia, giving it a striking, stencil-cut structure. Trench Slab follows in a refined, dignified classic serif, its lowercase nearly touching the caps, so a long page reads dense and orderly.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, its tall lowercase bodies filling each line with sturdy, confident texture. Stentiga's spread-out outlines float above it.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-erode: Erode, a text serif with a broad g and a, flows with a gentle swell and thinning of stroke. Stentiga's thick crossbars and spacious tracking add a luxurious opening.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-trench-slab: Contemporary and bold, True North stacks a middle band so tall its lines look stocky, with curves that refuse to close. Trench Slab steps in as a dignified classic serif, and a modest body size lets its tight gap between x-height and caps stay crisp.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-bespoke-slab: Visitor's gaping e mouths and uniform pixel-like strokes give it a nostalgic, digital stamp. Bespoke Slab takes over as a text serif with tall, grounded lowercase, so a long read feels sturdy and refined.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-erode: Erode is a serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Beside Visitor's ruler-straight, digital lines, its modest stroke modulation keeps a long stretch of text feeling editorial, dignified and unhurried.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-hoover: Visitor draws nostalgic, digital letters with a laser-etched, constant-width trace and big open bowls. But Hoover, a robust text serif with a generous e and compressed ascenders, keeps a long passage feeling refined and compact.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-bespoke-slab: Woodgod brings a commanding, vintage voice, with wide channels into each bowl and lowercase that nearly meets the capitals. And Bespoke Slab, a text serif with tall bodies, carries a long passage in a grounded, refined way.
gen-eater-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, its tall lowercase bodies giving each line real presence on the page. Eater, dark and aggressive with wide gaps and short ascenders, sits beside it like a rougher cousin.
